prompt: Three pizza-topping checkboxes update a summary label. Complete updateSummary so the label shows the selected topping texts joined with ", " (or "none" when nothing is checked).
explanation: Each JCheckBox fires an ItemEvent when its selected state flips, and all three boxes share the same listener, so any change funnels into updateSummary. The method rebuilds the label from scratch: collect the getText() of every selected box in order, then either join them with String.join(", ", ...) or fall back to "none". Recomputing the whole summary on every event is simpler and less error-prone than trying to patch the previous string.
hints: Loop over the three boxes in order and collect box.getText() for each one where isSelected() is true.
String.join(", ", list) joins a list of strings with a comma and space.
Handle the empty case separately: if the list is empty, show "none".
